evidence.positive: On the demo-demo tenant, staged adult patients via the admin API with heights under 60 in, a CREATININE 1.1 mg/dL observation, evicted the Redis ContextPatient cache, then ran POST /api/cds/medication-selection as loopuser for m-lidocaine and m-ketorolac. Female 142.24 cm (56 in), 70 kg: the RuleEngine 'Rule context' log line showed 'idealWeight=36.3 kg, actualWeight=70 kg, adjustedWeight=49.78 kg, crCl=Optional[48.08]'; w-last-local-anesthetic-max-dose returned details WEIGHT_CALCULATION_TYPE=IDEAL, PATIENT_WEIGHT_KG=36.3, INTRAVENOUS_MAX_DOSE=54 mg; w-ketorolac-dose-adjustment fired with CURRENT_CRCL=48.1. Male 142.24 cm, 70 kg: 'idealWeight=40.8 kg', lidocaine max 61 mg on ideal weight. Female 139.7 cm (55 in), 72 kg: 'idealWeight=34 kg', lidocaine max 51 mg, CrCl 47.5 so the ketorolac CrCl warning fired. All match the spec formula base + 2.3 x (height - 60).
evidence.negative: Same staging for a female 162.56 cm (64 in), 70 kg: 'idealWeight=54.7 kg, adjustedWeight=60.82 kg, crCl=Optional[58.75]', lidocaine max 82 mg on ideal weight, w-ketorolac-dose-adjustment did not fire ('patient doesn't meet criteria') - heights of 60 in or more are unchanged. Non-positive cutoff: female 96.52 cm (38 in), 30 kg gave 'crCl=Optional.empty, idealWeight=null, adjustedWeight=null'; a-ketorolac-low-crcl abstained with 'unknown ideal weight' (visible via /api/admin/rule/evaluations/not-fired); w-last-local-anesthetic-max-dose fell back to WEIGHT_CALCULATION_TYPE=ACTUAL, PATIENT_WEIGHT_KG=30, max 45 mg. No negative IBW, adjusted weight, CrCl or dose appeared anywhere.
evidence.red_check: Compiled the parent commit's Calculator.java (lombok @Slf4j replaced with an explicit LoggerFactory logger) with the container's javac and copied Calculator.class and Calculator$1.class into /app/classes/com/guided/orci/utils/, which precedes the orci-models jar on the jib classpath; restarted the container (readiness UP in 15 s). Re-ran the under-60-inch scenarios against the pre-fix class: female 55 in, 72 kg logged 'idealWeight=57 kg, actualWeight=72 kg' and lidocaine max 85 mg (vs 34 kg / 51 mg post-fix); female 56 in, 70 kg logged 'idealWeight=54.7 kg' with CrCl 58.75 so the ketorolac CrCl warning did NOT fire (fires post-fix at 48.1); female 38 in, 30 kg logged 'idealWeight=96.1 kg, actualWeight=30 kg, adjustedWeight=69.66 kg' with CrCl 28.98 instead of null. Reverted by deleting the two shadow class files (confirmed 0 left under /app/classes), verified the orci-models jar md5 unchanged (f7b648d64613b86fb581256cd73a9605) before and after, restarted (readiness UP in 18 s), and re-ran the 55 in and 38 in cases: 'idealWeight=34 kg, actualWeight=72 kg' and 'idealWeight=null' respectively, confirming the shipped behaviour is back.

caveats: Creatinine had to be staged as an observation plus a manual Redis ContextPatient cache eviction; the cache key is populated before the observation is added, so without eviction the rules see creatinine=null.
Exercised via the medication-selection API and RuleEngine logs, not the dosing form UI; the UI only renders the same rule details.
Only the lidocaine LAST max-dose and ketorolac CrCl rules were exercised as IBW consumers; meperidine, vancomycin and procainamide paths use the same IPatient.getIdealWeight and were not run.

The ticket's open PM question (whether a clinical minimum height or floor applies above the 0 kg cutoff) is a product decision, not a code defect; the shipped behaviour matches the acceptance criteria as written.

automation.assessment: CaculatorUtilsTest (merged with the fix) already covers both sexes under 60 in, monotonic decrease with height, the 60 in boundary and the non-positive cutoff at the unit level, and RenalMeperidineCrCl10RuleTest covers the null-IBW abstain. No qa-suite test stages a short adult: LAMD-001 uses a 10-year-old (pediatric, actual weight) and MISC-007 uses a normal-height adult. Worth locking in end-to-end is one short-adult case showing the IBW-driven max dose and CrCl flip, since that is the user-visible consequence.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: Adults under 60 in now get the spec IBW (56 in woman 36.3 kg, 56 in man 40.8 kg), and the lidocaine max dose and ketorolac CrCl warning follow it.
Negative: A 64 in woman still gets 54.7 kg, and a 38 in woman gets no IBW so the CrCl rules abstain instead of producing a negative value.
Red check: Swapping in the pre-fix calculator class made the 56 in woman read 54.7 kg and the 38 in woman 96.1 kg, suppressing the ketorolac CrCl warning; restoring the shipped class brought the correct values back.

Automation: Unit coverage merged with the fix; three supplemental qa-suite scenarios for a short adult are proposed.
